items.content_html: Turjuman is a free, open-source desktop application for fast and accurate translation between English and Arabic. Built with C# and ASP.NET Core, it features a rich database of over 100,000 words, smart search with typo tolerance, text-to-speech pronunciation, and works completely offline. Designed for students, professionals, and everyday use.
